title: Thỏ và Rùa
style: 3D Pixar-like cartoon for kids, bright soft lighting, saturated warm colors, gentle depth of field

characters.hare: slim white hare, long ears with pink inner ears, big blue eyes, wearing a small red scarf, cocky grin
characters.tortoise: small round green tortoise, brown hexagon-patterned shell, kind brown eyes, tiny round glasses

settings.meadow: sunny green meadow with wildflowers and a dirt race path, morning light
settings.start: dirt race path with a wooden start line banner (no letters), forest animals cheering on the sides, morning light
settings.tree: big shady oak tree beside the race path, midday light
settings.finish: finish line ribbon across the path on a small hill, late afternoon golden light

scenes.action: The Hare zooms around the Tortoise in circles, laughing and pointing at him, while the Tortoise smiles calmly.
scenes.subtitle: Ngày xưa, có chú Thỏ chạy nhanh nhưng rất kiêu ngạo.

scenes.action: The Tortoise raises one finger and calmly proposes a race; the Hare bursts out laughing and nods.
scenes.subtitle: Rùa bình tĩnh nói: "Mình thi chạy nhé!"

scenes.action: Both stand at the start line; an owl waves a flag and the Hare dashes off in a cloud of dust while the Tortoise takes his first slow step.
scenes.subtitle: Cuộc đua bắt đầu! Thỏ lao vút đi.

scenes.action: Far ahead, the Hare looks back, sees no one, yawns, lies down in the shade and falls asleep with a smug smile.
scenes.camera: medium shot, slow pan to the hare
scenes.subtitle: Thấy Rùa còn xa, Thỏ nằm ngủ một giấc.

scenes.action: The Tortoise walks steadily past the sleeping Hare, step by step, determined, careful not to wake him.
scenes.subtitle: Rùa vẫn chậm rãi bước, không dừng lại.

scenes.action: The Hare wakes up, stretches, then panics, ears shooting up, and sprints off at full speed.
scenes.subtitle: Thỏ giật mình tỉnh dậy, vội vàng chạy.

scenes.action: The Tortoise crosses the finish ribbon as forest animals cheer; the Hare arrives just behind, out of breath.
scenes.subtitle: Nhưng Rùa đã về đích trước!

scenes.action: The embarrassed Hare shakes the Tortoise's hand and both smile as the sun sets behind them.
scenes.subtitle: Chậm mà chắc, kiên trì sẽ chiến thắng.
